description_en: Updates the basic information of a media file
name: UpdateMedia

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media file whose basic information you want to update. You can obtain the ID from the MPS console > media management > media list
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新基本信息的媒体ID。可以通过MPS控制台 > 媒体管理 > 媒体列表获取
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The title of the media file. Chinese characters, English letters, and digits are supported.

If you do not specify this parameter, the field is cleared.
The value must be UTF-8 encoded and can be up to 128 bytes in size
parameters.help_zh:
媒体标题。支持中英文、数字等。

若不设置则清空此字段。
UTF8编码，最大128字节
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The description of the media file. Chinese characters, English letters, and digits are supported.

If you do not specify this parameter, the field is cleared.
The value must be UTF-8 encoded and can be up to 1,024 bytes in size
parameters.help_zh:
媒体描述。支持中英文、数字等。

若不设置则清空此字段。
UTF8编码，最大1024字节
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the cover image. This is the storage address of the cover image that you want to set. You can obtain the address from the MPS console > workflow management > media bucket or the OSS console > my access paths.

The value can be up to 3,200 bytes in size.
The URL must comply with RFC 2396 (UTF-8 encoded and URL-encoded). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh:
封面URL。即您需要设置的封面的存储地址，可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 媒体Bucket或OSS控制台 > 我的访问路径获取。

不超过3200字节。
URL遵循RFC 2396（UTF-8编码，并进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en:
The category ID. The value must be an integer.
If you do not specify this parameter, the field is cleared.
The value cannot be a negative number
parameters.help_zh:
类目ID，整数。
若不设置则清空此字段。
不能为负数
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,). You can specify up to 16 tags.
Each tag can be up to 32 bytes in size.
The value must be UTF-8 encoded
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

用半角逗号（,）分隔，不超过16个标签。
单个标签不超过32字节。
UTF8编码
parameters.name: tags

CensorState.description_en:
The content moderation status of the video. Valid values:

Initiated: The video is uploaded, but moderation is not completed.

Pass: The video is uploaded and has passed moderation
CensorState.description_zh:
视频审核状态。取值：

Initiated：初始（上传成功审核未完成）。

Pass：通过（上传成功审核已通过）

CoverURL.description_en: The URL of the cover image

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description of the media file

State.description_en:
The status of the file. Valid values:

Normal: normal.

Deleted: deleted
State.description_zh:
文件状态。取值范围：

Normal：正常。

Deleted：已删除

URL.description_en: The OSS bucket of the input file

Format.description_en: The format. Supported formats: mov, mp4, m4a, 3gp, 3g2, and mj2

Height.description_en: The height of the media file

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media file

PublishState.description_en:
The publish status of the media file, which indicates whether the media file is published. Valid values:

Initiated: initial state.
UnPublish: unpublished. The playback permission of the OSS file is Private.
Published: published. The playback permission of the OSS file is Default.
Deleted: deleted
PublishState.description_zh:
媒体发布状态，表示是否对外发布媒体。取值：

Initiated：初始。
UnPublish：未发布，OSS播放文件权限为Private。
Published：已发布，OSS播放文件权限为Default。
Deleted：已删除

Size.description_en: The size of the media file

Width.description_en: The width of the media file
